entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: Sequence of 403 aa has reviewed CoaBC homologs with 45–46% identity and approximately 99% query coverage; inferred assignment, not direct experimental identification.
Reviewed CoaBC references catalyze phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligation and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation in coenzyme A biosynthesis.
Reference CoaBC annotations report FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; these are homology-based for this query.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed CoaBC homologs are annotated for two sequential CoA-biosynthesis steps: formation of phosphopantothenoylcysteine and its decarboxylation to phosphopantetheine.

entities.name: Cysteine decarboxylase homolog
observations: A reviewed homolog aligns at 58.4% identity over 87.8% of query and is annotated to decarboxylate cysteine and cysteine sulfinic acid; this raises alternative or related substrate-specificity interpretation.
